_provenance.criterion: max relative error of each APPROXIMANT's own output, evaluated at calibration time over its declared band. NOT a claim about the deployed circuit: the 1-iteration CKKS bootstrap's refresh floor is coarser than this target over part of the magnitude range (holds 2^-10 on |x| in [1.38,246] but 1e-4 only on [12.85,76.4]), so end-to-end 1e-4 would require 2-iteration Meta-BTS. The target's purpose is to put the approximation an order below the scheme's own noise, not to bound it.
_provenance.count_convention: kernel iterations; iteration 1 is the seed product
_provenance.softmax_domain: declared Chebyshev band recovered from (alpha, beta)
